density.description: Extinction per world unit at baseHeight.

heightFalloff.description: Exponential density reduction per world unit above baseHeight.

fog.description: Height-dependent exponential fog integrated along the camera ray. Replaces linear fog.

count.description: Number of shadow maps the directional light splits the view into.

split.description: Blend between even splits (0) and logarithmic splits (1). Higher values give nearby cascades more resolution.

maxDistance.description: Camera distance in meters that directional shadows cover.

cascades.description: Cascaded shadow maps for the shadow-casting directional light. Replaces the single map sized by extent.

oneOf.description: Solid background color with no environment lighting.

sunEntityId.description: Directional light entity whose direction places the sun. Defaults to the first directional light.

turbidity.description: Atmospheric haze. Higher values whiten the sky.

rayleigh.description: Rayleigh scattering. Higher values deepen blue and sunset tones.

intensity.description: Multiplier for the sky background and its image-based lighting.

oneOf.description: Physical sky model used as background and environment lighting.

exposure.description: Linear exposure multiplier applied before tone mapping.

bloom.description: Glow around bright areas, computed on HDR light before tone mapping.

threshold.description: Scene luminance above which pixels bloom. Values above 1 limit bloom to emissive and very bright surfaces.

softness.description: Width of the transition around the threshold.

radius.description: Spread of the glow, from tight (0) to wide (1).

intensity.description: Strength of the glow added to the image.

vignette.description: Darkens the image toward its corners after tone mapping.

intensity.description: Darkening at the corners. 0 has no effect and 1 reaches black.

radius.description: Normalized distance from the center, 0 to the corner 1, where darkening starts.

softness.description: Distance over which darkening reaches full intensity.

shadowBias.description: Depth offset for this light's shadow map. Small negative values such as -0.0005 remove shadow acne. Defaults to 0.

shadowNormalBias.description: World-unit offset along the surface normal before the shadow lookup. Values such as 0.02 remove acne on slopes. Defaults to 0.

castShadow.description: Render shadows from this light. At most 4 point and spot lights cast shadows per scene.

shadowBias.description: Depth offset for this light's shadow map. Small negative values such as -0.0005 remove shadow acne. Defaults to 0.

shadowNormalBias.description: World-unit offset along the surface normal before the shadow lookup. Values such as 0.02 remove acne on slopes. Defaults to 0.

assetId.description: Prepared image asset slot projected onto the receiver.

receiverId.description: Primitive or rigid model entity in this scene that receives the projection.

size.description: Projector width, height and depth in local units. The entity transform scales and rotates the box.

renderOrder.description: Overlapping decals draw in ascending order, with scene entity order breaking ties.

decal3d.description: Presentation-only textured projection onto one explicit rigid receiver. At most 32 decals per scene.
